create_pgvector_client: create a PgvectorClient instance that initializes a PostgreSQL connection with pgvector extension and creates the document_chunk table
insert_vector_items: insert a list of VectorItem objects into a named collection with optional encryption via pgcrypto
upsert_vector_items: upsert VectorItem objects into a collection, updating existing items by id or inserting new ones
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in a collection using cosine distance with optional metadata filters and limit
query_collection_items: query items from a collection by metadata filter keys and values with an optional limit
